description: '''Zimbabwean hip hop''' is a variety of [[hip hop music]] that is popular in [[Zimbabwe]]. It emerged in the early 1990s. Prominent artists include [[Holy Ten]], [[Tehn Diamond|{{proper name|Tehn}} Diamond]], Mlue Jay, Mahcoy, [[Saintfloew]]''',''' TiGonzi, Takura and [[T3rry Tempo]].
